posts.author: The Blazeror
posts.title: Some suggestions.
posts.html:
Hey, i got some suggestions. Sorry for the bad English.

First, i see that /note is used alot. So i think it would be cool if you had to buy the notes. Would make less ppl spam it and make the job supplier better.

Also all this cars that ppl just jump out from in the middle of the car, then they dont move them when you ask. So maby make cops able to set notes to a car, that allways costs say like 500. And to drive your car you must press E on the note and pay. The money goes to noone. Abusing it = Demote.

Or make a new job that is able to hit the car with some kind of baton so it goes inisde the backpack of the owner. And you can only hit it if it has been left for 5 minutes locked. Abusing it = Demote.

Just something like that cus i hate those cars that are in the roads that ppl dont move. Also it would be cool to sell notes.

posts.title: Re: Some suggestions.
posts.html:
I think the buying notes idea is good.

You could buy notes from the supplier, 2k for 10 Notes.

then to use I have two ideas.

Either just stick with what we have /note <text>

or the harder to code way,

Use the note (from your inv) (it brings up a screen where you type a message) then click ok.

As for fines on cars, this is a great idea - it could use the same method as the padlocks when it attaches to the car. I can see it being hugely abused though. Also where should the money go?
